nodes.dialogue_text: Yudhishthira! You have never spoken an untruth in your life. Tell me, is it true? Is my son Ashwatthama dead?
[Mutters 'the elephant' so softly that Drona, amid the blare of Krishna's conch, does not hear it. Yudhishthira's chariot, which always floated above the ground, instantly drops to the earth.]
